photos.title: Plain as simple
photos.description: This collection is inspired by the minimalistic Japanese Ma (間) philosophy. Japanese culture and their traditional paintings alongside their flower arranging styles have been sources of inspiration to us. The concept of “Ma” is something that relates to all aspects of life. It has been described as a pause in time, an interval or emptiness in space. We need the absence of something to understand it more profoundly. If we want to understand light, we must first understand darkness. If we want to understand a work of art such as photography, a painting or a piece of music, it is better to examine its absence in their empty spaces. As stated by the great Mozart: “The music is not in the note but in the silence between”

photos.title: Dark Secret
photos.description: In this photo, the art of dark beauty creates a dramatic environment. I always wanted to create a different style and dramatic form of art. Photography is an art but as a fashion photographer many peoples ask and say to me " is fashion photo is an art ? ". That's why I decided to capture a different and dramatic form of photography in fashion and portrait genre.
